channel.title: Claude Code Switcher Changelog
channel.description: Update feed for Claude Code Switcher.

item.title: Version 0.9.11
item.description:
• Fixed: switching to an account a teammate had been using often ended at Claude Code's login screen. Claude's logins are single-use — each refresh replaces the one before it — so whoever last used a shared account held the only working copy and had no way to return it. The pool kept handing out a login that had already been retired.
  • Fixed: switching away from an account could discard the newest login for it, quietly breaking that account for everyone else.
  • Fixed: switching by hand never refreshed a nearly-expired login the way automatic switching did, so it failed minutes later with no explanation. It now refreshes first, and says so plainly when an account genuinely needs a re-login.
  • Changed: shared accounts are reserved while you use them, and reservations are now on by default. Two people on one login is what retires each other's tokens.
  • Removed: "Rotate to next account", which duplicated "Switch to best account".

item.title: Version 0.9.10
item.description: • Fixed: reserving one of your own accounts showed a warning-styled "held by (your own name)" that never cleared. It now reads "reserved by you", and the warning styling is kept for a teammate's hold.

item.title: Version 0.9.9
item.description:
• Security: MCP server logins and plugin secrets are no longer uploaded to the team pool alongside a shared account token.
  • Fixed: a "held by" badge could stay on screen forever, and the account stayed usable while it showed.
  • Fixed: quitting the app left your reservation stranded for teammates.
  • Fixed: choosing "local only" for an account was permanent. You can now move accounts into and out of the pool freely.
  • Fixed: "Leave team" could leave the wrong team if you belong to more than one.
  • Fixed: toast messages never disappeared, and a failed switch could strand a reservation.
  • Added: "Rotate to next account" in the panel, and dismissable errors in Settings.

item.title: Version 0.6
item.description:
• Fixed: the remove/trash button on account rows didn't respond to clicks.
  • Fixed: onboarding had no way to quit, see About, or switch to local-only mode once past the first sign-in screen.

item.title: Version 0.5
item.description: • Added auto-updates — the app can now check for and install new versions itself (Settings → About / General).
